indicate no specific preference Course overview The missing step between data collection and research progress is a lack of training for researchers in crucial skills for effectively managing and analysing data often in large amounts This hands on workshop teaches researchers the fundamental data skills they need to conduct their work and provides high quality domain specific training covering Audience The course is aimed at graduate students and other researchers in the life sciences who would like to learn good practices in data management and analysis The course is ideally suited to students without prior experience in computational research but some familiarity with working with tabular data on a computer is welcome Modules Data organisation and cleaning Versioning with Git
